title: sse-streaming-partial-json-delimiter-ordering-fix
author: Ava Martinez
description: Fixes several edge cases in the SSE streaming framer/parser that caused malformed partial-JSON payloads and out-of-order token/event delimiters under high-concurrency conditions. Root cause: a race in the framing state machine where multi-chunk JSON payloads could emit delimiter tokens before the associated token-event frames were fully buffered, and a subtle off-by-one in delimiter detection when CRLF and LF mixes were present. This PR updates the framer to 1) enforce atomic delimiter emission for multi-chunk partial-JSON sequences, 2) canonicalize delimiter detection to accept mixed CRLF/LF boundaries, 3) reorders token/event emission so token events are always emitted before synthetic delimiter events, and 4) adds stricter integration tests and fuzz cases for compatibility with the OpenAI-compatible streaming layer. Included are a small runtime-optimized rewrite of the framer (Rust), server-side parser hardening (Python), OpenAI-compat adapter fixes to ensure valid chunk ordering for function/tool-calling payloads, and backports for the 1.8 release branch. See linked Linear ENG-4982 for more context.
commits_summary: initial: add canonical delimiter detector and basic tests | fix: ensure token-event ordering and buffer flush semantics | perf: optimize framer loop to avoid extra allocations | tests: add integration and fuzz tests for mixed CRLF/LF streams | docs: stream framing behaviour note
ci_checks: integration-tests: initially failed (flaky test), re-run: pass
discussion: Sanjay Patel: Found a race when multiple small chunks contain both token events and delimiters. Can you ensure ordering is deterministic under concurrency?
Ava Martinez: Addressed by buffering token events per-stream and emitting delimiter events only after token buffers are flushed. Added tests and a small perf optimization to avoid allocations.

Leah Kim: The compat adapter still produced an extra empty chunk for the function-calling finish event. Confirmed and fixed; now we canonicalize empty payload emission to a single "[DONE]"-style event for OpenAI compat layer.
Marco Rossi: Integration fuzzing found CRLF/LF mixing cases that previously mis-detected delimiters. The new detector covers both; added fuzz corpus sample. Approving after CI green.
Sanjay Patel: Verified on staging with high concurrency (1000 streams), no delimiter reordering observed. Approving.
release_notes: Fixes for SSE streaming framing and partial-JSON handling: canonicalized delimiter detection, token/event ordering fixes, OpenAI-compat adapter improvements, and new integration/fuzz tests. Backported to release/1.8.
